summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload on installer host
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs enumerates process.platform and process.arch, probes libc via `ldd --version` and reads /etc/os-release for 'Alpine' to pick a musl-baseline vs glibc-baseline build, then downloads a pinned Bun binary (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods it, and executes the sibling file math_init.js under that freshly-downloaded runtime. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line obfuscator.io-style payload with hex-mangled identifiers, a large constants array, an array-rotation shuffler, and a character-substitution decoder — content opaque to Node-based registry scanners. The package's advertised purpose is trivial (lib/index.js is `export default 'John'`), so there is no benign reason to smuggle an alternate runtime to run an obfuscated 727KB blob at install time. The result is arbitrary code execution on every installer host on `npm install`, with cross-platform coverage (linux glibc/musl, darwin, win32; x64/arm64).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
